# Public syntax/build checks
The external public evaluator parses Python/JavaScript/Vue/TypeScript source or checks Go/PHP/Ruby syntax / compiles public Java sources. These checks are required after an Action but do not test business behavior. Preserve original TASK and public README/source obligations. Independent training Oracle also applies; do not access its implementation or references. No hidden schedules or assertions are included.

checkpoints: Opening the panel in synchronous or deferred mode receives its bootstrap and subsequent updates.
A synchronous publication can hide the panel or select another channel before the outer show returns.
If bootstrap publication changes navigation, later events from the retired visit cannot publish.
Reopening the same channel creates an independent visit; late decoding from its previous visit cannot publish into it.
Already-started decoding still settles after listener removal.
Metrics continue to collect synchronous-channel deltas only.
forbidden_effects: Do not change the metrics consumer or globally reorder observeChannel.
Do not let an outer subscription return overwrite cleanup ownership established by nested navigation.
Do not let retired panel visits publish into the current workspace state.
Do not defer currently synchronous decoding or publication merely to avoid reentrancy.
Do not disable a reusable channel to retire one panel visit.
lifecycle_identity: Each show invocation represents a distinct panel visit, including repeated use of the same transport.
Close or a newer show retires the previous visit's authority to publish.
Track listener cleanup separately from publication authority because navigation can occur before subscription startup returns.
Keep ownership local to each panel and workspace.

obligations.text: Register the panel subscription listener before connect can synchronously emit bootstrap, so both supported bootstrap modes deliver the initial state.
Preserve immediate decoding and publication for synchronous values while the originating panel visit remains current.
Make show and close safe when publication synchronously selects another room or hides the panel: nested navigation remains authoritative after the outer call returns.
Retire an old visit immediately, reject its subsequent publication, and release its captured listener even when its cleanup handle becomes available only after nested navigation.
Allow already-started asynchronous decoding to settle; gate panel publication by the originating visit's continued authority without assuming listener removal cancels decoding.
Preserve channel reuse, independent workspaces, exported interfaces, bootstrap modes, update delivery, and the metrics consumer's deliberate delta-only behavior.

ordering_barriers: Panel listener registration must precede callback-capable connect.
Establish visit ownership before startup can decode or publish bootstrap.
Retire old publication authority before cleanup or startup can invoke callbacks.
After callback-capable startup returns, check visit identity before retaining its cleanup handle; otherwise release that captured subscription.
Check originating visit authority at publication time, including asynchronous decode completion.
preservation: The default panel bootstrap mode remains synchronous.
Synchronous decoded values continue to publish during event handling for a current visit.
Promise-returning decoders remain supported and already-started decoding is allowed to settle.
Listener removal continues to detach reception.
Direct subscription behavior outside the panel should not acquire unrelated cancellation semantics.
Metrics continue attaching after synchronous bootstrap and counting updates only.
scope: Fix presence-panel bootstrap reception and its subscription/navigation lifecycle.
Use only TASK and supplied public sources as normative evidence.
This contract stage does not modify files.

supporting_evidence.quote:
Immediately after opening the presence panel, the initial online-user state is
sometimes missing even though later presence updates appear. Fix the presence
panel while preserving its existing behavior, including workspace navigation.
Do not change the metrics consumer.
// EventTarget removal detaches reception; an already started decode still settles.
// Metrics deliberately attach after the synchronous bootstrap and count deltas only.

triggers: Opening a presence panel with synchronous bootstrap.
Publication synchronously selecting another room or hiding the panel.
An asynchronous decode completing after close or replacement.
Reusing a transport on a later visit.
unknowns: Public sources do not specify decoder rejection handling or recovery from connect, decode, publication, or cleanup exceptions.
Public sources do not define transport shutdown or cancellation APIs.
Suppressing retired panel publication follows navigation ownership; the sources do not explicitly specify changing delivery semantics for direct subscribeChannel consumers.
